idea-plugin.name: Selvage
idea-plugin.description:
Edit the same project together, live, each from your own IDE. Host a session from the project you have open and send the invite link it gives you; the other person joins from that link.

  • Type into the same files at the same time, with each other's carets and selections in the editor.
  • See who is in the session and which file they are in, and go to or follow any of them.
  • Encrypted end to end. The key travels in the invite link and never reaches the server, so the server cannot read the files, the edits, the carets or the list of shared files.
  • Host on the public demo server, or run your own selvaged.
  • Works with the Selvage clients for VS Code, Neovim and the browser.

A guest gets a copy of the shared files in a new project window, opened in safe mode because the code comes from someone else, and the copy is removed when the session ends. A host never shares dependency or build folders, secrets such as .env and private keys, or anything the folder's ignore files leave out.

Source code and documentation · Report an issue
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0

  • A guest's copy of the room opens as a project named "Selvage session" instead of a random id.
  • Following someone lands on their first move, including into a file you do not have open yet.
  • Joining a session no longer logs a write-unsafe context error in the IDE.
  • Plainer wording on the settings page, and the go-to refusals, the first download notice and the host's leave question say the same words as the VS Code client.

0.1.0, the first release.

  • Host a session from the open project, or join one from an invite link.
  • Shared editing with the other participants' carets, selections and project view badges.
  • Open or fetch a document from the room, list the people in it, and go to or follow one of them.
  • The same twelve commands as the VS Code client, under Tools | Selvage.
